description: Χώροι καταφυγής πολιτών σε περίπτωση σεισμού is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Περιφέρεια Αττικής. Som tillflyktsorter (eller församling eller församling) anses öppna fria utrymmen inom staden som syftar till säker frisättning av befolkningen, vilket manifesterar sig som den första reaktionen på en seismisk händelse. Skyddade platser kan också användas som omedelbart boende (t.ex. tält, husvagnar eller fartyg), med en vistelsetid på timmar upp till några dagar (cirka två), dvs. Coverage: Περιφέρεια Αττικής. The portal shows the English title as "Zufluchtsorte für Bürger im Erdbebenfall" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Περιφέρεια Αττικής. Its keywords include Πολιτησ, Από μετάπτωση, Προστασια, repository.data.gov.gr. The listing shows 2026-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
